data.name: Mamdud
data.gender_notes: Mamdud is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who gives glory, One who bestows honour. The name Mamdud carries the meaning “Glory, Honour” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mamdud usually hope their child will grow to embody glory, honour and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who serves as a shield, One who protects
data.etymology: Mamdud belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Glory, Honour.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mamdud total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: ممدود
in_arabic.meaning: الاسم ممدود يعني الممدود والمطول في مدحه وتمجيده
in_arabic.long_meaning: الاسم ممدود هو من الأسماء التي تعبر عن المدح والتمجيد، حيث يشتق من الفعل مدّ الذي يعني التمديد والإطالة في الشيء، وينسب إلى الله عز وجل الذي هو أمدح وأتم مجداً، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم ذكر الممدود في سياق المدح والثناء على الله تعالى

in_urdu.name: ممدود
in_urdu.meaning: نام ممدود مطلب ہے ممدود و مدح میں مطول
in_urdu.long_meaning: ممدود نام کا مطلب ہے کہ جس کی مدح کی جائے اور اس کا تمدید کیا جائے، یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے جہاں اس کا معنی ہے کہ جس کی خوبیوں کو بیان کیا جائے اور اس کی ستائش کی جائے، اسلامی تقالید میں یہ نام اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ نام اللہ تعالیٰ کی صفات سے ملتا جلتا ہے جو کہ تعریف و تمجید کا مستحق ہے

in_english.name: Mamdud
in_english.meaning: Mamdud means praised and extended in commendation
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mamdud originates from Arabic roots and signifies being praised and having one's virtues extolled. In Islamic tradition, it reflects attributes of being commendable and worthy of praise. The name Mamdud is associated with positive personality traits such as being charismatic and appreciated by others. Historically, it has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote someone who is highly esteemed and revered

data.cultural_impact: The name Mamdud holds deep cultural significance in the Islamic world as it connotes the idea of bestowing honor and giving glory. It is a name that evokes a sense of dignity, respect, and nobility. The name Mamdud is often given to boys born into well-respected and prestigious families, as it represents the idea of carrying on a noble legacy and upholding a proud family heritage. In many Islamic cultures, the naming ceremony is an important social event, and the bestowal of such a name is a source of great pride for the family.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Mamdud holds profound significance as it is a reminder that the source of all honor and glory comes from God. The name Mamdud serves as a reminder that it is through God's grace and mercy that we are given the ability to bestow honor upon others and to give glory to God. It is a name that encourages us to strive towards living a life of dignity, respect, and nobility, and to use our God-given abilities to bring honor and glory to God and to those around us. Ultimately, the name Mamdud serves as a daily reminder of the importance of being a conduit of God's love and blessings in the world.
